title: Lenovo CTO on AI Product Rollout, Vision
description:
Lenovo is unveiling its new AI products and partnerships at its annual Tech World conference, which this year coincides with CES in Las Vegas. CTO Tolga Kurtoğlu says the company is focusing on providing on-device Hybrid AI technology for its customers and sees embedding artificial intelligence into robotics as the future of its adoption. He speaks with Annabelle Droulers in the sidelines of CES.
